text:
Situation: Pantoprazole sodium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2019-05-28 and remained listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 89 months. Current inventory across Corvale sites provides 16 days on hand at Corvale East, 19 days at Corvale General, and 19 days at Corvale Lakeside.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows pantoprazole sodium was posted on 2019-05-28 and remained on the list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: The rule-based best option is to buy from Avenacy, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. However, Avenacy, LLC's label names no plant we could place, so the manufacturing site cannot be verified from the label. Other alternate manufacturers ranked by the rule include BE Pharmaceuticals Inc., Baxter Healthcare Company, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Cardinal Health 107, LLC, also not on FDA's shortage list today and with labels that name no plant we could place. Because the links are weak or some records fail data checks, we must verify Avenacy, LLC's current supply availability and confirm the manufacturing site before purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies Avenacy, LLC's current supply availability and confirms the manufacturing site; Pharmacy Director approves purchase if verified.
2. If Avenacy, LLC cannot be verified, buyer verifies BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. supply and site; Pharmacy Director approves purchase if verified.
3. If needed, buyer verifies Baxter Healthcare Company supply and site; Pharmacy Director approves purchase if verified.
4. Buyer monitors inventory daily across all Corvale sites; Pharmacy Director receives weekly status updates.

Not recommended: Purchasing from any alternate manufacturer without confirming both current supply availability and manufacturing site.
